summary: If the Kohen Gadol made a mistake in a ruling for himself and then did the sin by mistake, he brings a bull as a korban. His ruling for himself is like the beis din's ruling for everyone.

chunks.en: If the anointed Kohen ruled for himself,
chunks.st: In a case where an anointed priest, i.e., the High Priest, issued an erroneous ruling for himself
chunks.stMore: permitting performance of an action prohibited by Torah law,

words.note: The Kohen Gadol, who was anointed with special oil.

chunks.en: by mistake, and did it by mistake,
chunks.st: if he issued the ruling unwittingly and then unwittingly performed the transgression in accordance with his ruling,

chunks.en: he brings a bull as a korban.
chunks.st: he is liable to bring a bull as a sin-offering for an unwitting transgression by the anointed priest.

chunks.en: If he ruled by mistake but did it on purpose,
chunks.st: If he issued the ruling unwittingly, and performed the transgression intentionally,

chunks.en: or ruled on purpose but did it by mistake,
chunks.st: or if he issued the ruling intentionally and performed the transgression unwittingly,

chunks.en: he is free, because the ruling of the anointed Kohen for himself
chunks.st: he is exempt from liability to bring any offering, as there is a principle: The legal status of the ruling of an anointed priest for himself is like

chunks.en: is like the ruling of the beis din for the whole community.
chunks.st: that of the ruling of the court for the general public.
chunks.stMore: Therefore, the High Priest is liable to bring the bull as a sin-offering for his unwitting transgression in a case when the court would be liable to bring the bull as a communal sin-offering for an unwitting transgression performed by the general public.

summary: If the Kohen Gadol ruled and sinned alone, he brings his own korban; if he was part of the beis din's ruling, he is forgiven together with everyone. A korban is brought only when part of a mitzvah was changed, even for avodah zarah.

chunks.he: הוֹרָה בִפְנֵי עַצְמוֹ וְעָשָׂה בִפְנֵי עַצְמוֹ,
chunks.en: If he ruled by himself and did it by himself,
chunks.st: If the anointed priest issued a ruling by himself and performed a transgression by himself,

chunks.en: he is forgiven by himself.
chunks.st: he achieves atonement by himself by bringing a bull as his sin-offering.

chunks.he: הוֹרָה עִם הַצִּבּוּר וְעָשָׂה עִם הַצִּבּוּר,
chunks.en: If he ruled together with the community and did it with the community,
chunks.st: If he issued a ruling with the general public, i.e., the Sanhedrin, and performed a transgression with the general public, i.e., the Jewish people,

chunks.en: he is forgiven together with the community.
chunks.st: he achieves atonement with the general public.

chunks.en: Because the beis din does not bring a korban unless
chunks.st: As, the court is not liable unless

chunks.en: they ruled to cancel part of a mitzvah and keep part of it,
chunks.st: the judges issue a ruling to nullify part of a commandment and to sustain part of that commandment,

chunks.en: and the same is true for the anointed Kohen.
chunks.st: and likewise with regard to the ruling of the anointed priest.

chunks.en: And not for avodah zarah either,
chunks.st: And the court and the priest are not liable for a ruling with regard to idol worship

words.note: Avodah zarah is serving idols.

chunks.he: עַד שֶׁיּוֹרוּ לְבַטֵּל מִקְצָת וּלְקַיֵּם מִקְצָת:
chunks.en: unless they ruled to cancel part of it and keep part of it.
chunks.st: unless they issue a ruling to nullify part of that commandment and to sustain part of it.

summary: The beis din and the Kohen Gadol bring a korban only if they forgot the halachah and the people did the act by mistake. It must also be a sin that is punished with kares if done on purpose.

chunks.en: They bring a korban only if they forgot
chunks.st: The court is liable only for absence of awareness

chunks.en: the halachah, together with doing the act by mistake.
chunks.explain: The judges forgot the halachah, and then the people sinned by mistake.
chunks.st: of the matter, leading to an erroneous ruling, together with unwitting performance of the action by the general public on the basis of that ruling.

chunks.en: And the same is true for the anointed Kohen.
chunks.st: And likewise, the anointed priest
chunks.stMore: is liable only for an erroneous ruling and his unwitting performance of an action on the basis of that ruling.

words.note: The Kohen Gadol.

chunks.en: And for avodah zarah too,
chunks.st: And the court and the priest are liable for a ruling with regard to idol worship

words.note: Avodah zarah is serving idols.

chunks.en: they bring a korban only if they forgot
chunks.st: only for absence of awareness

chunks.en: the halachah, together with doing the act by mistake.
chunks.st: of the matter, leading to an erroneous ruling, together with unwitting performance of the action on the basis of that ruling.

chunks.he: אֵין בֵּית דִּין חַיָּבִין עַד שֶׁיּוֹרוּ
chunks.en: The beis din does not bring a korban unless they ruled
chunks.st: The court is not liable to bring an offering for absence of awareness of the matter unless they issue a ruling

chunks.en: about a sin that is punished with kares if done on purpose, and needs a chatas korban if done by mistake.
chunks.st: with regard to a matter for whose intentional violation one is liable to receive karet and for whose unwitting violation one is liable to bring a sin-offering.

words.note: A punishment from Hashem of being cut off.
A korban brought for a sin done by mistake.

chunks.en: And the same is true for the anointed Kohen.
chunks.st: And likewise the anointed priest is liable only for such a ruling.

chunks.en: And not for avodah zarah either,
chunks.st: Neither is the court liable to bring a sin-offering for idol worship

chunks.en: unless they ruled about a sin
chunks.st: unless the judges issue a ruling with regard to a matter

chunks.en: that is punished with kares if done on purpose, and needs a chatas if done by mistake.
chunks.st: for whose intentional violation one is liable to receive karet, and for whose unwitting violation one is liable to bring a sin-offering.

summary: The beis din does not bring a korban for a mistaken ruling about the mitzvos of keeping the Beis HaMikdash tahor, but it does for the mitzvos of niddah.

chunks.en: They do not bring a korban for a mitzvah to do
chunks.st: The court is not liable to bring a bull as an unwitting communal sin-offering for issuing a ruling with regard to a positive mitzva

words.note: A mitzvah that tells us to do something.

chunks.en: or a mitzvah not to do, about the Beis HaMikdash,
chunks.explain: Mitzvos about not coming into the Beis HaMikdash when tamei.
chunks.st: or a prohibition related to the defiling of the Temple
chunks.stMore: by one being there while ritually impure, or the defiling of its sacrificial foods by one partaking of them while ritually impure. There is a positive mitzva to remove impure people from the Temple, and there is a prohibition against entering the Temple while in a state of ritual impurity.

words.note: A mitzvah not to do something.

words.en: that are about the Beis HaMikdash

chunks.en: and one does not bring an asham talui for
chunks.st: And one does not bring a provisional guilt-offering for

words.note: An asham talui is a korban brought when one is not sure he sinned.

chunks.en: a mitzvah to do or a mitzvah not to do about the Beis HaMikdash.
chunks.st: a positive mitzva or a prohibition related to the defiling of the Temple or its sacrificial foods.

words.en: that are about the Beis HaMikdash

chunks.en: But they do bring a korban for a mitzvah to do
chunks.st: But the court is liable to bring a bull for a positive mitzva

chunks.en: or a mitzvah not to do about niddah,
chunks.st: or for a prohibition that is related to a menstruating woman,

words.note: The laws of a kind of tumah of a married woman.

chunks.en: and one brings an asham talui for a mitzvah to do
chunks.st: and one brings a provisional guilt-offering for a positive mitzva

words.note: An asham talui is a korban brought when one is not sure he sinned.

chunks.en: or a mitzvah not to do about niddah.
chunks.st: or for a prohibition that is related to a menstruating woman.

chunks.en: What is the mitzvah to do about niddah?
chunks.st: What is the positive mitzva that is related to a menstruating woman?

chunks.en: "Stay away from a niddah."
chunks.st: Distance yourself from the menstruating woman.
chunks.stMore: If a man engages in intercourse with a woman and she begins menstruating, he is required to separate from her.

chunks.en: And the mitzvah not to do?
chunks.st: And what is the prohibition?

chunks.en: "Do not come close to a niddah."
chunks.st: Do not engage in intercourse with a woman whom you know is a menstruating woman.

summary: The beis din does not bring a korban for a mistaken ruling about three special kinds of sins. The Rabbis argue whether the king is also free from korbanos for them.

chunks.en: They do not bring a korban for "hearing the voice,"
chunks.explain: A witness who falsely swears he knows nothing.
chunks.st: The court is not liable for issuing a ruling with regard to hearing of a voice,
chunks.stMore: i.e., a false oath of testimony taken by a witness who refuses to testify on behalf of a litigant who demands that he testify,

chunks.en: or for "saying with the lips,"
chunks.explain: A false promise made with a shevuah.
chunks.st: or for an utterance of the lips,
chunks.stMore: i.e., a false oath stated about some matter,

chunks.en: or for making the Beis HaMikdash or its korbanos tamei.
chunks.st: or for the defiling of the Temple or its sacrificial foods.

chunks.en: And the king is like them.
chunks.st: And the status of the king is like
chunks.stMore: that of the court, and he is exempt from bringing an offering in those cases;

words.note: The Nasi here means the king.

chunks.en: These are the words of Rabbi Yosi HaGlili.
chunks.st: this is the statement of Rabbi Yosei HaGelili.

words.note: A great Rabbi of the Mishnah from the Galil.

chunks.en: Rabbi Akiva says,
chunks.st: Rabbi Akiva says:

chunks.he: הַנָּשִׂיא חַיָּב בְּכֻלָּן חוּץ מִשְּׁמִיעַת הַקּוֹל,
chunks.en: the king must bring a korban for all of them, except for "hearing the voice,"
chunks.st: The king is liable in all of those cases except for the case of hearing of a voice,
chunks.stMore: and even in that case, his exemption is not intrinsic to the mitzva. Rather, it is for technical reasons,

chunks.he: שֶׁהַמֶּלֶךְ לֹא דָן וְלֹא דָנִין אוֹתוֹ,
chunks.en: because the king does not judge, and others do not judge him;
chunks.st: as the king neither judges others nor do others judge him;

chunks.en: he does not act as a witness, and others are not witnesses about him.
chunks.st: he does not testify nor do others testify against him.
chunks.stMore: Therefore, a demand that he testify is not applicable.

summary: This mishnah lists which korban each person brings for a sin done by mistake: a regular person, the king, the Kohen Gadol and the beis din. For avodah zarah the korbanos are different.

chunks.en: For all the mitzvos in the Torah that one is punished for
chunks.st: For all mitzvot that are in the Torah for whose intentional

chunks.en: with kares if done on purpose, and needs a chatas if done by mistake,
chunks.st: violation one is liable to receive karet and for whose unwitting violation one is liable to bring a sin-offering,

words.note: A punishment from Hashem of being cut off.
A korban brought for a sin done by mistake.

chunks.en: a regular person brings a female lamb or a female goat,
chunks.st: the individual brings a ewe or female goat for their unwitting transgression,

chunks.en: and the king brings a male goat,
chunks.st: and the king brings a male goat for their unwitting transgression,

words.note: The Nasi here means the king.

chunks.en: and the anointed Kohen and the beis din bring a bull.
chunks.st: and an anointed priest and a court who issued an erroneous ruling bring a bull.

words.note: The Kohen Gadol.

chunks.en: And for avodah zarah,
chunks.st: And for unwittingly engaging in idol worship,

words.note: Avodah zarah is serving idols.

chunks.en: a regular person, the king and the anointed Kohen bring a female goat,
chunks.st: the individual, and the king, and the anointed priest bring a female goat,

chunks.en: and the beis din brings a bull and a goat:
chunks.st: and the court brings a bull and a goat:

chunks.en: the bull as an olah and the goat as a chatas.
chunks.st: A bull for a burnt-offering and a goat for a sin-offering.

words.note: A korban that is burned completely on the mizbe'ach.

summary: This mishnah teaches who brings an asham korban and who brings a special korban whose size depends on how rich a person is.

chunks.en: An asham talui:
chunks.st: With regard to a provisional guilt-offering,

words.note: An asham talui is brought when one is not sure he sinned.

chunks.en: a regular person and the king must bring it,
chunks.st: the individual and the king are liable,

words.note: The Nasi here means the king.

chunks.en: but the anointed Kohen and the beis din are free.
chunks.st: and an anointed priest and a court are exempt.

words.note: The Kohen Gadol.

chunks.en: A sure asham:
chunks.st: With regard to a definite guilt-offering,

words.note: An asham brought for a sin one knows he did.

chunks.en: a regular person, the king and the anointed Kohen must bring it,
chunks.st: the individual, the king, and the anointed priest are liable,

chunks.st: and a court is exempt.

chunks.en: And what do they bring?
chunks.st: And what offering are they liable to bring?

chunks.en: A korban that goes up and down.
chunks.explain: A rich person brings an animal; a poor person brings birds or flour.
chunks.st: It is a sliding-scale offering based on their financial circumstances, as delineated in the Torah (see Leviticus 5:1–13).
